This local action uploads only the two validated JSON inventories in `runtime-reports`. The repository permits local actions only. The official `@actions/artifact` client is pinned in package.json and its complete dependency lock; the workflow installs it with lifecycle scripts disabled. Its artifact-service credentials are supplied by the GitHub Node action runtime and are never printed. Missing reports, symlinks and path escapes fail before upload. Retention is 14 days. Run `node test.mjs` after the locked install for the local path and upload-contract tests.
